description: Analytical data warehouse with full T-SQL support. Optimized for large-scale queries and reporting. Supports cross-database queries with lakehouses in the same workspace. Connect via TDS (SQL Server protocol) from any SQL client.
definition_format: dacpac or sqlproj (sqlproj is the API default)

definition_parts.description: Binary DACPAC payload when format is dacpac
SQL project and SQL source files when format is sqlproj
Optional item metadata; applied by update-definition --update-metadata

flags.--definition: Public definition JSON, inline or as @file

notes: Creation accepts either creationPayload (for collation) or definition, never both
Create/get-definition/update-definition support dacpac and sqlproj public definitions
Every definition part requires path, payload, and payloadType
Query via TDS: connection string is <id>.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com
Supports three-part naming for cross-database queries within same workspace
SQL input accepts inline --sql, @file path, or stdin piping
connection-string command resolves the endpoint automatically
